title: Vegetable and Fruit Juice Drink, High in Vitamin C

content.title: About
content.content: The vegetable‑fruit juice is a blend of fresh vegetables and fruits enriched with a high level of vitamin C (5334 mg/L). The drink retains the natural taste and aroma of its ingredients, providing a quick source of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The vitamin C content is about ten times the daily recommended intake for an adult.
The juice is produced by cold‑pressing, which preserves most of the nutrients.
Combining vegetables (e.g., carrot, beet) with fruits (orange, kiwi) enhances the bioavailability of vitamin C.
The product contains no added sugar, preservatives, or artificial flavors.
Packaged in recyclable PET bottles to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: High vitamin C levels boost the body's defense mechanisms, helping to fight infections.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Flavonoids and carotenoids in the juice neutralize free radicals and reduce oxidative stress.

items.title: Skin health
items.content: Vitamin C is essential for collagen synthesis, promoting skin elasticity and a healthy complexion.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Fiber from the fruits and vegetables supports intestinal motility and normal digestion.

items.title: Reduced fatigue
items.content: Vitamin C participates in energy metabolism, helping to lessen feelings of tiredness and weakness.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to specific fruits or vegetables used in the blend.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Natural sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, natural fruit sugars can raise the product's glycemic index.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: Vitamin C degrades quickly once the bottle is opened, so it should be consumed within 2‑3 days.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: The juice is ready to drink straight from the bottle. It can be enjoyed chilled, added to smoothies, used as a base for cocktails, or poured over salads for extra flavor and nutrition.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C. Keep the cap tightly closed after opening. Shelf life after opening is about 3 days.
